data.name: Fording
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old English word 'ford', meaning 'a place where a river can be crossed'. This name symbolizes the journey of faith and the crossing of life's challenges.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes crossing spiritual thresholds and overcoming life's challenges.

data.cultural_impact: The name Fording holds a significant cultural impact as it reminds us of our historical past where people forded rivers as they traveled, exploring new lands and experiences. It is a reminder of our ability to overcome challenges and adapt to new circumstances. The name can also be seen as a reflection of our modern-day experiences, as we continue to navigate the rapids of life and forge new paths.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Fording carries a profound meaning as it symbolizes the journey of faith and the crossing of life's challenges. Just as a river can be crossed, so too can we overcome the obstacles that stand in the way of our spiritual growth. This name encourages us to keep moving forward, trusting that God will provide the way, and reminding us that we are not alone in our journey. It is a reminder that with faith, we can ford even the toughest rivers and overcome the greatest challenges.
